limitations: The physical conversion uses AllowPartial because the source still fails the unchanged strict callback/correlation gate.
The proof covers the admitted SORTENTSTABLE and two ACDBASSOCNETWORK profiles; it does not claim closure of other associative record families, unknown tails or the entire drawing graph.
Fresh libdxfrw readback is transport evidence, not independent CAD consumer or platform qualification.
No support claim or external item is promoted.
